fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Relationship/affinity matrix, 107 rows x 128 i8 columns. Rows 1..80 form 8 groups of 10: members of a group are +50 to each other and -25 to the paired group (1-10 vs 11-20, 21-30 vs 31-40, ...), 0 to self and everyone else; columns 81..128 and rows 81..107 are 0. What the ids are (senator groups? personalities?) is unverified.
